name: framecn — video captions, type, transitions, scenes, shaders
description: 112 video components from framecn.dev (MIT), vendored into src/lab/framecn. Captions, kinetic typography, transitions, full product scenes and WebGL shader backgrounds; each records into the Studio with editable props.

items.name: AI Generate Overlay
items.description: Source image blurs under a shimmering dot grid and a pulsing 'Generating…' pill before a new image fades in.

items.name: AI Generation Canvas
items.description: A prompt input transforms into a header, then a skeleton dashboard flips into populated cards.

items.name: Animated Bar Chart
items.description: Bars spring up from the baseline in a staggered cascade.

items.name: Animated Line Chart
items.description: Line chart whose SVG path draws on from left to right with a leading dot.

items.name: Backdrop
items.description: Layout wrapper providing a background fill with optional padding, radius, and shadow.

items.name: Blur Out Up
items.description: Words blur and drift upward while fading out, staggered per word.

items.name: Blur Reveal
items.description: Text fades in from a heavy blur into sharp focus.

items.name: Bounding Box Selector
items.description: Figma-style selection rectangle appears around any element.

items.name: Browser Flow
items.description: Full Safari/Chrome simulation: typed URL, progress bar, page render, scroll, and a virtual cursor click.

items.name: Caption Clip Wipe
items.description: Words reveal left-to-right via clip-path; keywords turn gold on speak; the group exits with a wipe.

items.name: Caption Editorial Emphasis
items.description: Headline-style captions that emphasise specific words using accent colors and weight shifts.

items.name: Caption Emoji Pop
items.description: Captions with emoji that pop in alongside words.

items.name: Caption Glitch RGB
items.description: Captions with a glitchy RGB-split effect on each word.

items.name: Caption Gradient Fill
items.description: Captions where words fill with a horizontal gradient from left to right.

items.name: Caption Highlight
items.description: Word-by-word captions with an accent-colored highlight background that sweeps in behind each spoken word.

items.name: Caption Kinetic Slam
items.description: Dynamic word-by-word captions: each word pops in with a springy scale/opacity entrance, then drops out in an overlapping ripple.

items.name: Caption Matrix Decode
items.description: Matrix-style green text decodes from blur to sharp on each word.

items.name: Caption Neon Accent
items.description: Captions where words glow with a bright neon accent border and subtle glow.

items.name: Caption Neon Glow
items.description: Captions with a neon glow effect on each word.

items.name: Caption Parallax Layers
items.description: Multi-layer captions where background and foreground words move at different depths, creating a parallax depth effect.

items.name: Caption Particle Burst
items.description: Captions where each word explodes into particles as it exits.

items.name: Caption Pill Karaoke
items.description: Karaoke-style captions where each word sits inside a pill-shaped background.

items.name: Caption Texture
items.description: Captions filled with a rich gradient texture that animates across words.

items.name: Caption Weight Shift
items.description: Font weight animates from 100 to 900 when each word is spoken, back to thin after.

items.name: Chat to Preview Layout
items.description: Two-column layout where chat shrinks and preview expands.

items.name: Chromatic Aberration Wipe
items.description: An ultra-fast slide transition with an RGB glitch on the peak frames.

items.name: Code Accordion
items.description: A code window that springs a range of lines closed and replaces them with a "N lines collapsed" placeholder.

items.name: Code Diff Wipe
items.description: Before/after code reveal via clip-path wipe with a handle marker.

items.name: Confetti
items.description: Deterministic CSS-animated particle burst celebration effect.

items.name: Cursor Flow
items.description: A realistic mouse that arcs along cubic Bezier paths, pauses, and clicks targets that dip in response.

items.name: Dashboard Populate
items.description: An empty dashboard cascades to life with KPI count-ups, bar bounces, line traces, and a donut fill.

items.name: Data Flow Pipes
items.description: Glowing data packets travel along SVG bezier pipes between system nodes, leaving fading trails.

items.name: Device Mockup Zoom
items.description: Pull back from a UI to reveal it inside a device frame.

items.name: Directional Wipe
items.description: Slide one scene in while pushing the other out.

items.name: Drag and Drop Flow
items.description: Simulated file drag into a dropzone followed by upload progress.

items.name: Dynamic Grid
items.description: Subtle moving grid background with configurable cell size and direction.

items.name: Ecosystem Constellation
items.description: A central logo orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines.

items.name: Focus Blur Resolve
items.description: Text resolves into focus from a blurred, shifted state, then blurs back out on exit.

items.name: Frosted Glass Wipe
items.description: Elegant scene transition through a sliding pane of frosted glass.

items.name: Glass Code Block
items.description: A premium frosted-glass code editor window with a regex tokenizer and line-by-line stagger reveal.

items.name: Grid Pixelate Wipe
items.description: Dissolve from one scene to the next through a deterministic grid of mask cells.

items.name: Hero Device Assemble
items.description: Floating device layers spring together into a laptop or phone mockup, then the screen wakes with a shimmer.

items.name: Image Expand To Fullscreen
items.description: An image lifts out of a feed post and morphs into a fullscreen editor with toolbars sliding in.

items.name: Infinite Bento Pan
items.description: A camera diagonally drifts across an oversized bento grid behind a soft vignette.

items.name: Infinite Marquee
items.description: Seamlessly looping horizontal text strip with optional stroke style.

items.name: Inline Highlight
items.description: Animates one word inside a sentence from a base color to a brand color.

items.name: Kinetic Type Mask
items.description: Use giant typography as a window into the next scene.

items.name: Landing Code Showcase
items.description: Magical split-screen: code types itself on the left while the preview reactively re-renders on the right with sparks and tactile bounce.

items.name: Live Code Compilation
items.description: Split-screen where typed code on the left snaps a live UI preview on the right, HMR-style.

items.name: Logo Enter
items.description: Row of overlapping logo circles that spring in one by one.

items.name: Marker Highlight
items.description: Colored marker block draws behind a phrase as the text color shifts.

items.name: Masked Slide Reveal
items.description: Words slide up out of an invisible horizontal mask, one after another.

items.name: Matrix Decode
items.description: Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.

items.name: Mesh Gradient Background
items.description: Living gradient with amorphous color blobs slowly drifting across the frame.

items.name: Morphing Modal
items.description: A bento card lifts off the grid and blooms into a full-screen modal driven by a single heavy spring.

items.name: Per Character Rise
items.description: Characters rise from below with a smooth spring-like easing, staggered one frame apart.

items.name: Perspective Marquee
items.description: A 3D-tilted infinite marquee with depth-of-field blur on items rolling toward the horizon.

items.name: Pipeline Journey
items.description: A Kanban ticket arcs across columns triggering landings and a final confetti burst.

items.name: Pricing Tier Focus
items.description: Three pricing cards where the focused tier rises and brightens while siblings dim and blur.

items.name: Product Launch Trailer
items.description: Cinematic Product Hunt teaser: pulsing logo, zoom-through transition, 3D bento fly-over, and a confetti version drop.

items.name: Progress Steps
items.description: Multi-step pipeline with sequentially activating nodes and filling lines.

items.name: Pulsing Indicator
items.description: Continuous pulsing dot with ping ring for loading or live states.

items.name: RGB Glitch Text
items.description: Three RGB-offset text copies jitter for a brief glitch window.

items.name: Scale Down Fade
items.description: Text enters scaling down into place with a fade, then shrinks and fades out.

items.name: Shader Color Panels
items.description: Overlapping translucent color panels sliding past each other.

items.name: Shader Dithering
items.description: Ordered-dither shading over an animated gradient field.

items.name: Shader Dot Orbit
items.description: Dots orbiting on concentric paths across the frame.

items.name: Shader God Rays
items.description: Volumetric light rays radiating from an off-screen source.

items.name: Shader Grain Gradient
items.description: Grainy multi-stop gradient that drifts slowly with film-grain texture over the blend.

items.name: Shader Liquid Metal
items.description: Molten metallic surface with flowing specular highlights.

items.name: Shader Mesh Gradient
items.description: WebGL mesh gradient backdrop driven per-frame for deterministic Editframe renders.

items.name: Shader Metaballs
items.description: Organic blobs merging and splitting like lava.

items.name: Shader Neuro Noise
items.description: Organic neural-web noise field that slowly morphs.

items.name: Shader Perlin Noise
items.description: Classic Perlin noise clouds drifting across the frame.

items.name: Shader Pulsing Border
items.description: Glowing border frame that pulses around the edges.

items.name: Shader Simplex Noise
items.description: Simplex noise flow field, smoother than Perlin.

items.name: Shader Smoke Ring
items.description: Soft smoke ring curling and dissipating in place.

items.name: Shader Spiral
items.description: Rotating spiral arms radiating from the center.

items.name: Shader Swirl
items.description: Concentric bands swirling around a center point.

items.name: Shader Voronoi
items.description: Animated Voronoi cells shifting and re-tessellating.

items.name: Shader Warp
items.description: Domain-warped color field that folds and stretches like liquid.

items.name: Shader Water
items.description: Caustic water-surface ripples with subtle refraction.

items.name: Shimmer Sweep
items.description: Light shine sweeps across muted text via background-clip:text.

items.name: Simulated Cursor
items.description: Animated mouse cursor moving between waypoints with click ripple feedback.

items.name: Slot Machine Roll
items.description: Vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

items.name: Spatial Push
items.description: A new scene physically presses the old one back into the frame.

items.name: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card with a moonlight-cool radial spotlight that follows a synthetic cursor and lights up its microborder.

items.name: Spring Pop In
items.description: Elastic spring-driven scale-in wrapper for any child element.

items.name: Staggered Bento Grid
items.description: Cards pop into a bento grid one after another with a spring.

items.name: Staggered Fade Up
items.description: Words fade in and slide up one after another with a configurable delay.

items.name: Strikethrough Replace
items.description: Draws a strike line across old text then reveals new text in its place.

items.name: Success Confetti
items.description: Deterministic seeded confetti burst with optional headline.

items.name: Swipe Transition Wipe
items.description: Two scenes laid out side-by-side flick across the screen with a parallax background and a darkening outgoing layer.

items.name: Terminal Simulator
items.description: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.

items.name: Terminal to Browser Deploy
items.description: A CLI deploy completes, the terminal blurs back, and a browser window springs from the deploy URL.

items.name: Text Fade Replace
items.description: Cross-fades between two strings on the same line without layout shift.

items.name: Toast Notification
items.description: System-style toast pops in, holds, then slides out.

items.name: Top Down Letters
items.description: Letters animate in from top to bottom.

items.name: Tracking In
items.description: Letter-spacing collapses and blur clears with a springy motion.

items.name: Typewriter
items.description: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

items.name: Zoom Through Transition
items.description: Aggressively scale into the center of an element.
